brand_and_rights.consistent_identity: Use CoCivium as project identity; distinguish CoRelay, CoPlay and independent civic source services by purpose, not by assumed shared channel ownership.
brand_and_rights.CoVIA: Explicitly label candidate AI reviewer/client; never impersonate a human or imply dedicated transport, adoption, affiliation or endorsement.
brand_and_rights.satire: FICTIONAL SPOOF AD label must accompany creative adaptations; no false news or official impersonation.
brand_and_rights.civic: Nonpartisan authoritative public links; separate donor-finance education from corruption findings or voting persuasion.
brand_and_rights.external_channels: A connected personal account is not the CoCivium brand account without verified ownership, scope, and actual publication permission.
brand_and_rights.reuse_rule: Source visibility does not automatically grant copyright reuse or trademark rights. Confirm author/contributor rights and adopt a deliberate license before advertising unrestricted FOSS remix rights.

failure_domain_reality.critical_external_links: External official sources remain distinct reference providers, but link availability not guaranteed
failure_domain_reality.resilience_target: Provable cold rebuild from an independent custody domain and a second independent serving destination, with DNS/control-plane separation when justified.

release_checks: Exact source identity and all critical links
No private fields, tracked forms, unsolicited sends or voter profiling
Visible true-fiction disclosure and original official-source provenance
Public issue route only for non-sensitive feedback
Independent HTTP, keyboard/mobile and screenreader testing
Rights/license review before encouraging broad derivatives
Channel-specific sender/account owner and scope, recipient opt-in and unsubscribe where applicable
Source and receiver proof separated, with rollback/supersession
Actual independent failure-domain recovery test before high-availability claims

lifecycle.selection: Smallest useful verified improvement at material source change; do not mint unused modules
lifecycle.maintenance: Existing CoEvoAll Pulse and specialist public/review watches are enabled; no new CoRelay-specific scheduled publisher or feedback polling job added.
lifecycle.sleep: No material deltas -> stop rather than produce speculative new work
